description: This file defines the configuration class for the I18N Plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements initialization logic by registering I18N-related services into a dependency injection container.

classes.name: I18nPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for initializing the I18N plugin, responsible for registering I18N services during plugin setup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering I18N services into the dependency injection container.
